description.sk: Výdatné chili s fazuľou – uvar veľký hrniec a obedy máš na niekoľko dní.
description.en: A hearty chili with beans: cook a big pot and lunch is sorted for days.

steps.sk: Na oleji speň nakrájanú cibuľu a papriku, asi 6 minút. Pridaj cesnak.
steps.en: Soften the chopped onions and pepper in the oil for about 6 minutes. Add the garlic.

steps.sk: Pridaj mäso a opekaj ho, kým nie je nikde ružové, asi 8 minút. Vmiešaj pretlak a všetko korenie a minútu opekaj.
steps.en: Add the beef and brown until no pink remains, about 8 minutes. Stir in the tomato paste and all the spices and fry for a minute.

steps.sk: Prilej paradajky a 200 ml vody, osoľ a var prikryté 30 minút.
steps.en: Add the tomatoes and 200 ml water, season with salt and simmer covered for 30 minutes.

steps.sk: Pridaj prepláchnutú fazuľu a var ešte 10 minút. Medzitým uvar ryžu.
steps.en: Add the rinsed beans and simmer for 10 more minutes. Meanwhile, cook the rice.

steps.sk: Podávaj s ryžou a lyžicou kyslej smotany. V mrazničke vydrží 3 mesiace.
steps.en: Serve with rice and a spoonful of sour cream. Freezes well for 3 months.

title.sk: Kuracie quesadilly so syrom a kukuricou
title.en: Chicken quesadillas with cheese and corn

description.sk: Chrumkavé tortilly plné roztečeného syra – rýchla večera aj jedlo na párty.
description.en: Crispy tortillas filled with melted cheese: a quick dinner or party food.

steps.sk: Mäso nakrájaj na drobné kúsky, okoreň rímskym kmínom, paprikou a soľou a na oleji opekaj 6 až 7 minút, kým nie je prepečené a bez ružovej farby.
steps.en: Cut the chicken into small pieces, season with cumin, paprika and salt and fry in the oil for 6–7 minutes until cooked through with no pink left.

steps.sk: Pridaj nakrájanú papriku a cibuľu a opekaj ešte 3 minúty. Vmiešaj kukuricu.
steps.en: Add the chopped pepper and onion and fry for 3 more minutes. Stir in the corn.

steps.sk: Na polovicu každej tortilly daj strúhaný syr a plnku a druhú polovicu preklop.
steps.en: Put grated cheese and filling on one half of each tortilla and fold over the other half.

steps.sk: Opekaj na suchej panvici 2 minúty z každej strany, kým tortilla nie je chrumkavá a syr sa neroztopí.
steps.en: Toast in a dry pan for 2 minutes per side until the tortilla is crisp and the cheese has melted.

steps.sk: Nakrájaj na trojuholníky a podávaj s kyslou smotanou.
steps.en: Cut into wedges and serve with sour cream.

description.sk: Ryža s limetkou, korenistá fazuľa, kukurica a avokádo – rastlinné a sýte.
description.en: Lime rice, spiced beans, corn and avocado: plant-based and filling.

steps.sk: Uvar ryžu podľa návodu a vmiešaj do nej polovicu limetkovej šťavy.
steps.en: Cook the rice according to the packet and stir in half the lime juice.

steps.sk: Na oleji minútu opekaj cesnak s rímskym kmínom a paprikou, pridaj prepláchnutú fazuľu, 4 lyžice vody a polovicu soli a var 5 minút.
steps.en: Fry the garlic with the cumin and paprika in the oil for a minute, add the rinsed beans, 4 tablespoons of water and half the salt and simmer for 5 minutes.

steps.sk: Salsa: paradajky a cibuľu nakrájaj nadrobno a zmiešaj s kukuricou, zvyšnou limetkovou šťavou, soľou a koriandrom.
steps.en: Salsa: finely chop the tomatoes and onion and mix with the corn, remaining lime juice, salt and coriander.

steps.sk: Do misiek daj ryžu, fazuľu a salsu a navrch plátky avokáda.
steps.en: Fill bowls with rice, beans and salsa and top with sliced avocado.

description.sk: Šťavnaté burgery s čedarom a kyslou uhorkou ako z bistra.
description.en: Juicy burgers with cheddar and pickles, just like from a diner.

steps.sk: Mäso rozdeľ na 4 časti a vytvaruj placky o niečo širšie ako žemle. Do stredu každej urob palcom jamku, aby sa pri pečení nevydula.
steps.en: Divide the beef into 4 and shape patties slightly wider than the buns. Press a dimple into the centre of each so they stay flat while cooking.

steps.sk: Placky osoľ a okoreň z oboch strán až tesne pred pečením.
steps.en: Season both sides with salt and pepper just before cooking.

steps.sk: Na rozpálenej panvici s olejom ich opekaj 4 minúty z každej strany. Mleté mäso má byť prepečené, vnútri bez ružovej farby (71 °C).
steps.en: Fry in a hot oiled pan for 4 minutes per side. Ground beef should be cooked through, with no pink inside (71 °C).

steps.sk: Poslednú minútu polož na každú placku plátok syra a prikry, aby sa roztopil. Žemle rozkroj a reznou stranou opeč.
steps.en: For the last minute, put a slice of cheese on each patty and cover so it melts. Halve the buns and toast them cut side down.

steps.sk: Žemle natri kečupom a horčicou a poskladaj burgery so šalátom, paradajkou, cibuľou a uhorkami.
steps.en: Spread the buns with ketchup and mustard and build the burgers with lettuce, tomato, onion and pickles.

title.sk: Ovsené vločky cez noc s jogurtom a čučoriedkami
title.en: Overnight oats with yogurt and blueberries

description.sk: Raňajky, ktoré si pripravíš večer za päť minút.
description.en: A breakfast you prepare the night before in five minutes.

steps.sk: V pohári alebo krabičke zmiešaj vločky, mlieko, jogurt, chia semienka, med a škoricu.
steps.en: Mix the oats, milk, yogurt, chia seeds, honey and cinnamon in a jar or container.

steps.sk: Zatvor a nechaj v chladničke aspoň 8 hodín alebo cez noc.
steps.en: Close and refrigerate for at least 8 hours or overnight.

steps.sk: Ráno premiešaj, podľa potreby zrieď lyžicou mlieka a navrch pridaj čučoriedky.
steps.en: In the morning, stir, loosen with a spoonful of milk if needed and top with the blueberries.

title.sk: Proteínové palacinky s tvarohom a banánom
title.en: Protein pancakes with quark and banana

description.sk: Nadýchané palacinky bez múky s množstvom bielkovín.
description.en: Fluffy flourless pancakes packed with protein.

steps.sk: Vločky, vajcia, tvaroh, banán a prášok do pečiva rozmixuj na hladké cesto. Nechaj ho 5 minút odstáť.
steps.en: Blend the oats, eggs, quark, banana and baking powder into a smooth batter. Let it rest for 5 minutes.

steps.sk: Panvicu jemne potri olejom a na miernom ohni na nej peč malé palacinky asi 2 minúty, kým sa na povrchu neurobia bublinky.
steps.en: Lightly oil a pan and cook small pancakes over low heat for about 2 minutes, until bubbles appear on top.

steps.sk: Otoč ich a dopeč ešte minútu. Podávaj s ovocím a kvapkou medu.
steps.en: Flip and cook for one more minute. Serve with fruit and a drizzle of honey.

description.sk: Korenisté mleté mäso v tortillách so šalátom, syrom a smotanou.
description.en: Spiced ground beef in tortillas with lettuce, cheese and sour cream.

steps.sk: Na oleji speň nakrájanú cibuľu, pridaj mäso a opekaj, kým nie je nikde ružové, asi 8 minút.
steps.en: Soften the chopped onion in the oil, add the beef and fry until no pink remains, about 8 minutes.

steps.sk: Pridaj cesnak, korenie, pretlak, soľ a 100 ml vody a povar 5 minút, kým zmes nezhustne.
steps.en: Add the garlic, spices, tomato paste, salt and 100 ml water and simmer for 5 minutes until thick.

steps.sk: Tortilly zohrej na suchej panvici.
steps.en: Warm the tortillas in a dry pan.

steps.sk: Plň mäsom, nakrájaným šalátom a paradajkami, strúhaným syrom a kyslou smotanou. Podávaj s limetkou.
steps.en: Fill with the beef, shredded lettuce, chopped tomatoes, grated cheese and sour cream. Serve with lime.

title.sk: Mac and cheese – cestoviny so syrovou omáčkou

description.sk: Krémové cestoviny s čedarom, americká klasika na zahriatie.
description.en: Creamy pasta with cheddar, an American comfort classic.

steps.sk: Cestoviny uvar v osolenej vode o minútu kratšie, ako je na obale.
steps.en: Cook the pasta in salted water for one minute less than the packet says.

steps.sk: Na masle opraž múku 1 minútu, postupne vmiešaj mlieko a za stáleho miešania var 4 minúty, kým nezhustne.
steps.en: Cook the flour in the butter for 1 minute, gradually whisk in the milk and simmer for 4 minutes, stirring, until thick.

steps.sk: Stiahni z ohňa, vmiešaj strúhaný čedar, horčicu, soľ a korenie, kým sa syr neroztopí.
steps.en: Take off the heat and stir in the grated cheddar, mustard, salt and pepper until the cheese melts.

steps.sk: Zmiešaj s cestovinami a hneď podávaj.
steps.en: Toss with the pasta and serve right away.

title.sk: Brazílska čierna fazuľa s klobásou a ryžou
title.en: Brazilian black beans with sausage and rice

description.sk: Zjednodušená feijoada: dymová fazuľa, ryža a čerstvý pomaranč.
description.en: A simplified feijoada: smoky beans, rice and fresh orange.

steps.sk: V hrnci opeč slaninu a chorizo nakrájané na kúsky, asi 5 minút. Pridaj cibuľu a cesnak a opekaj ďalšie 3 minúty.
steps.en: Fry the chopped bacon and chorizo in a pot for about 5 minutes. Add the onion and garlic and fry for 3 more minutes.

steps.sk: Pridaj fazuľu, rímsky kmín, bobkové listy, soľ a 400 ml vody a var 25 minút. Časť fazule roztlač, aby zhustla.
steps.en: Add the beans, cumin, bay leaves, salt and 400 ml water and simmer for 25 minutes. Mash some of the beans to thicken.

steps.sk: Medzitým uvar ryžu.
steps.en: Meanwhile, cook the rice.

steps.sk: Podávaj fazuľu s ryžou a plátkami pomaranča.
steps.en: Serve the beans with the rice and orange slices.

description.sk: Rýchly obed so zeleninou a množstvom bielkovín.
description.en: A quick lunch with vegetables and plenty of protein.

steps.sk: Mäso nakrájaj na prúžky, okoreň paprikou a soľou a na oleji opekaj 6 až 7 minút, kým nie je prepečené.
steps.en: Cut the chicken into strips, season with paprika and salt and fry in the oil for 6–7 minutes until cooked through.

steps.sk: Dresing: jogurt zmiešaj s prelisovaným cesnakom a citrónovou šťavou.
steps.en: Dressing: mix the yogurt with the crushed garlic and lemon juice.

steps.sk: Tortilly krátko zohrej, natri dresingom, pridaj šalát, nakrájanú zeleninu a mäso a pevne zroluj.
steps.en: Warm the tortillas briefly, spread with the dressing, add lettuce, sliced vegetables and chicken and roll up tightly.

description.sk: Tortilly plnené kuracím a fazuľou, zapečené v omáčke so syrom.
description.en: Tortillas filled with chicken and beans, baked in sauce with cheese.

steps.sk: Mäso var v osolenej vode 15 minút, kým nie je vnútri biele, a natrhaj ho vidličkami.
steps.en: Poach the chicken in salted water for 15 minutes until white inside, then shred it with forks.

steps.sk: Omáčka: na oleji speň cibuľu s cesnakom a korením, prilej passatu a var 5 minút.
steps.en: Sauce: soften the onion with the garlic and spices in the oil, add the passata and simmer for 5 minutes.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 200 °C. Mäso zmiešaj s fazuľou a tretinou omáčky.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Mix the chicken with the beans and a third of the sauce.

steps.sk: Tortilly naplň, zroluj a poukladaj do misy. Zalej zvyšnou omáčkou, posyp syrom a peč 20 minút.
steps.en: Fill and roll the tortillas and lay them in a dish. Pour over the remaining sauce, sprinkle with cheese and bake for 20 minutes.

steps.sk: Podávaj s kyslou smotanou.
steps.en: Serve with sour cream.

title.sk: Mexická polievka s fazuľou a kukuricou
title.en: Mexican black bean and corn soup

description.sk: Rastlinná korenistá polievka, ktorá zasýti ako hlavné jedlo.
description.en: A spiced plant-based soup as filling as a main course.

steps.sk: Na oleji speň nakrájanú cibuľu a papriku, pridaj cesnak a korenie a minútu opekaj.
steps.en: Soften the chopped onion and pepper in the oil, add the garlic and spices and fry for a minute.

steps.sk: Pridaj paradajky, fazuľu, kukuricu, bujón a 700 ml vody a var 20 minút.
steps.en: Add the tomatoes, beans, corn, stock cube and 700 ml water and simmer for 20 minutes.

steps.sk: Tretinu polievky rozmixuj a vráť späť, aby zhustla. Dochuť limetkovou šťavou a posyp koriandrom.
steps.en: Blend a third of the soup and stir it back in to thicken. Finish with lime juice and coriander.

description.sk: Pikantné prúžky kuracieho mäsa a papriky zabalené v tortille.
description.en: Spicy strips of chicken and pepper wrapped in tortillas.

steps.sk: Mäso nakrájaj na prúžky a premiešaj s korením, soľou, limetkovou šťavou a lyžicou oleja.
steps.en: Slice the chicken into strips and toss with the spices, salt, lime juice and a tablespoon of oil.

steps.sk: Na rozpálenej panvici opekaj mäso 6 minút, kým nie je prepečené. Odlož ho.
steps.en: Fry the chicken in a hot pan for 6 minutes until cooked through. Set aside.

steps.sk: Na zvyšnom oleji opekaj papriku a cibuľu nakrájané na prúžky 5 minút, aby zostali chrumkavé. Vráť mäso.
steps.en: Fry the sliced peppers and onion in the remaining oil for 5 minutes so they stay crisp. Return the chicken.

steps.sk: Podávaj v zohriatych tortillách s kyslou smotanou.
steps.en: Serve in warm tortillas with sour cream.

title.sk: Arroz con pollo – kura s ryžou
title.en: Arroz con pollo: chicken and rice

description.sk: Latinskoamerická klasika z jedného hrnca so zeleninou a korením.
description.en: A Latin American one-pot classic with vegetables and spices.

steps.sk: Na oleji opeč mäso zo všetkých strán dozlatista, asi 6 minút. Pridaj cibuľu, papriku a cesnak a opekaj 4 minúty.
steps.en: Brown the chicken on all sides in the oil, about 6 minutes. Add the onion, pepper and garlic and fry for 4 minutes.

steps.sk: Vmiešaj pretlak, korenie a ryžu a minútu opekaj.
steps.en: Stir in the tomato paste, spices and rice and fry for a minute.

steps.sk: Zalej 700 ml vody s bujónmi, prikry a var na miernom ohni 20 minút.
steps.en: Add 700 ml water with the stock cubes, cover and simmer over low heat for 20 minutes.

steps.sk: Pridaj hrášok, prikry a nechaj 5 minút dôjsť. Kura má byť vnútri prepečené (75 °C). Podávaj s koriandrom a limetkou.
steps.en: Add the peas, cover and leave for 5 minutes to finish. The chicken should be cooked through (75 °C). Serve with coriander and lime.

title.sk: Steak s chimichurri a pečenými zemiakmi
title.en: Steak with chimichurri and roast potatoes

description.sk: Argentínska bylinková omáčka k šťavnatému steaku.
description.en: An Argentine herb sauce for a juicy steak.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 220 °C. Zemiaky nakrájaj na mesiačiky, premiešaj s 2 lyžicami oleja a polovicou soli a peč 30 minút.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 220 °C. Cut the potatoes into wedges, toss with 2 tablespoons of oil and half the salt and roast for 30 minutes.

steps.sk: Chimichurri: nadrobno nasekaj petržlen a cesnak a zmiešaj s oreganom, čili, octom, 2 lyžicami oleja a štipkou soli.
steps.en: Chimichurri: finely chop the parsley and garlic and mix with the oregano, chili, vinegar, 2 tablespoons of oil and a pinch of salt.

steps.sk: Steaky nechaj 20 minút temperovať, osuš, osoľ a opeč na rozpálenej panvici so zvyšným olejom 3 minúty z každej strany na medium (55–57 °C v strede).
steps.en: Bring the steaks to room temperature for 20 minutes, pat dry, salt and sear in a very hot pan with the remaining oil for 3 minutes per side for medium (55–57 °C in the centre).

steps.sk: Nechaj 5 minút odpočinúť, nakrájaj proti vláknam, okoreň a podávaj so zemiakmi a chimichurri.
steps.en: Rest for 5 minutes, slice against the grain, season with pepper and serve with the potatoes and chimichurri.

description.sk: Mäso, ktoré sa po ôsmich hodinách samo rozpadá – do žemle s coleslawom.
description.en: Pork that falls apart after eight hours, for buns with coleslaw.

steps.sk: Paprikou, polovicou cukru, cesnakom, rímskym kmínom a soľou potri mäso zo všetkých strán.
steps.en: Rub the pork all over with the paprika, half the sugar, the garlic powder, cumin and salt.

steps.sk: Na dno pomalého hrnca daj cibuľu nakrájanú na kolieska, navrch mäso a podlej 100 ml vody.
steps.en: Lay the sliced onions in the slow cooker, put the pork on top and add 100 ml water.

steps.sk: Var na stupni LOW 8 hodín, kým sa mäso nedá ľahko roztrhať vidličkou (vnútri aspoň 90 °C).
steps.en: Cook on LOW for 8 hours until the pork pulls apart easily with a fork (at least 90 °C inside).

steps.sk: Mäso vyber, natrhaj vidličkami a premiešaj s kečupom, octom, horčicou, zvyšným cukrom a trochou výpeku.
steps.en: Lift out the pork, shred it with forks and mix with the ketchup, vinegar, mustard, remaining sugar and a little of the cooking juices.

steps.sk: Podávaj v opečených žemliach, napríklad s coleslawom.
steps.en: Serve in toasted buns, for example with coleslaw.

description.sk: Chrumkavý šalát z kapusty a mrkvy s ľahkým jogurtovým dresingom.
description.en: A crunchy cabbage and carrot salad with a light yogurt dressing.

steps.sk: Kapustu nakrájaj na tenké rezance a mrkvu nastrúhaj. Osoľ a premiešaj.
steps.en: Finely shred the cabbage and grate the carrots. Salt and toss.

steps.sk: Majonézu zmiešaj s jogurtom, octom, horčicou a cukrom.
steps.en: Mix the mayonnaise with the yogurt, vinegar, mustard and sugar.

steps.sk: Zmiešaj so zeleninou a nechaj aspoň 30 minút odležať v chladničke.
steps.en: Toss with the vegetables and chill for at least 30 minutes.

title.sk: Chrumkavé kuracie stripsy z teplovzdušnej fritézy

description.sk: Ako vyprážané, ale len s lyžičkou oleja.
description.en: Like deep-fried, with only a teaspoon of oil.

steps.sk: Mäso nakrájaj na prúžky hrubé ako prst a osoľ.
steps.en: Cut the chicken into finger-thick strips and salt them.

steps.sk: Strúhanku zmiešaj s paprikou a cesnakom. Prúžky obaľ v múke, rozšľahanom vajci a strúhanke.
steps.en: Mix the breadcrumbs with the paprika and garlic powder. Coat the strips in flour, beaten egg and the breadcrumbs.

steps.sk: Košík fritézy potri olejom, poukladaj prúžky v jednej vrstve a peč pri 200 °C 10 až 12 minút, v polovici otoč, kým nie sú zlatisté a vnútri biele (74 °C).
steps.en: Oil the air fryer basket, lay the strips in a single layer and cook at 200 °C for 10–12 minutes, turning halfway, until golden and white inside (74 °C).

steps.sk: Podávaj s kečupom alebo jogurtovým dipom.
steps.en: Serve with ketchup or a yogurt dip.
